metadata.title: The Galactic potential and the asymmetric distribution of hypervelocity stars

notes: No individually identified stars meet the criteria. The paper's unbound-HVS statement is only an aggregate reference to prior survey results ("some of them unbound to the Galaxy," T:p1-b12), and its analysis concerns "all of the observed B-type stars in the Brown et al. (2007b) survey" as an ensemble (T:p2-b1). Although it reports aggregate outgoing/ingoing counts (T:p3-b6) and plots the survey sample (I:p4-b0, I:p4-b1), neither the survey points nor the three unnamed MS stars (T:p1-b12, T:p3-b6) are linked to individual names or catalog identifiers in the supplied material. Aggregate population claims cannot establish eligibility for unidentified individual members.
